home.description: I'm a current Whitworth University student, and I've started building this campus-life app for pirates with one main goal: create a digital campus community, a platform where pirates can connect with each other, discover events, and navigate campus with ease. It's an unofficial, just-for-fun project — not affiliated with the university.

campusGuide.title: Campus Guide
campusGuide.description: Discover essential locations and resources around campus. Find study spaces, dining options, athletic facilities, and more to help you navigate campus life.

whatToBring.title: What to Bring
whatToBring.content: We're glad you will be a part of our community. Following are lists of items you'll need to bring along with items you may want to bring with you when you arrive on campus. Additionally, please read What's Provided for information about what is already in your room and What Not to Bring, which details items not allowed in the residence halls.

healthServices.title: Health Services
healthServices.content: Access health services, counseling, and wellness programs. Located in convenient campus locations to support your physical and mental well-being.

vehicleParking.title: Vehicle Registration & Parking
vehicleParking.description: A campus should be a 'park for the mind' where green spaces are to be cherished and natural beauty maintained.
vehicleParking.content: All personal vehicles parked on campus must be registered with security services. Faculty, staff and students should display a valid parking permit on their personal vehicle (including motorcycles) at all times.

dining.title: Campus Dining Services (Sodexo)
dining.description: Meal plans, menus, and dining hours
dining.content: Explore dining options provided by Sodexo, including daily menus, meal plan information, nutrition facts, and dining hall hours. Find what's being served today at the HUB and other campus locations.

foodDrink.title: Food & Drink
foodDrink.description: Dining options and cafes across campus
foodDrink.content: Explore various dining locations including the HUB, Pines Cafe, and other campus eateries. Find meal plans, grab-and-go options, and coffee shops.

hub.title: HUB
hub.description: Central hub for dining, studying, and socializing
hub.content: The HUB is the heart of campus life, offering multiple dining options, study spaces, and meeting areas. Perfect for grabbing a meal between classes or collaborating on group projects.

studySpaces.title: Study Spaces
studySpaces.description: Quiet areas and libraries for focused studying
studySpaces.content: Find the perfect study spot across campus. From the main library to quiet corners in academic buildings, discover spaces that match your study style and needs.

library.title: Library
library.description: Main campus library with extensive resources
library.content: Access books, research databases, study rooms, and computer labs. The library offers both quiet study areas and collaborative spaces for group work.

marketplaceTerms.title: Marketplace Terms & Safety
marketplaceTerms.summary: PirateHub is a bulletin board, not a store. We display listings; we don't sell, buy, hold money, ship, or guarantee anything. Every deal is strictly between the buyer and the seller.

platform.heading: PirateHub only hosts listings
platform.body: The marketplace lets pirates post listings so others can see what they offer. PirateHub is not a seller, buyer, broker, agent, or auctioneer, and is not a party to any agreement between users. We do not inspect, verify, endorse, or guarantee any item, service, price, user, or listing, and we make no representations about their quality, safety, legality, or accuracy.

noPayments.heading: No payments or transactions on PirateHub
noPayments.body: PirateHub does not process payments, hold funds, arrange delivery, offer refunds, or resolve disputes. Any communication, payment, and exchange happens off this site, between the users involved, at their own risk.

sellers.heading: Seller responsibilities
sellers.body: By posting a listing, you confirm and agree that:
items: You own the item or have the right to sell it.
The item is legal to sell and to own where the exchange takes place, and complies with campus policies.
Your listing, photos, videos, price, and condition are accurate and not misleading.
You are solely responsible for the sale, including any taxes, warranties, returns, or legal obligations.
You will not use the marketplace for scams, spam, or to collect other users' personal information.

prohibited.heading: Prohibited items
prohibited.body: The following may not be listed. Listings that appear to include them may be held for review or removed:
items: Weapons, firearms, ammunition, explosives, and weapon accessories
Alcohol, tobacco, vapes, and nicotine products
Drugs, cannabis products, drug paraphernalia, and prescription or controlled medications
Stolen, counterfeit, or replica goods, and items that infringe someone else's rights
Exam answers, test banks, essay-writing, or anything that helps academic dishonesty
Fake IDs, official documents, or accounts and credentials
Animals
Adult or sexual content or services
Recalled, hazardous, or unsafe items
Anything else that is illegal or against campus policy

buyers.heading: Buyer responsibilities
buyers.body: Buyers are responsible for evaluating items and sellers before agreeing to a deal. Meet in a public place, inspect items before paying, and never pay in advance or share financial information. Any purchase is made at your own risk.

moderation.heading: Moderation and reporting
moderation.body: Listings go through the same moderation as the rest of PirateHub. Moderators may hold, edit, or remove any listing, and restrict any account, at their discretion and without notice. Moderation does not mean a listing has been verified or approved as safe. If you see a listing that breaks these rules or looks like a scam, use the Report button.

liability.heading: No warranty and limitation of liability
liability.body: The marketplace is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the fullest extent permitted by law, PirateHub and its operators are not liable for any loss, damage, injury, or dispute arising from listings, communications, or transactions between users. You agree to release PirateHub and its operators from any claims related to your dealings with other users, and to hold them harmless from claims that arise from your own listings or conduct.

changes.heading: Changes to these terms
changes.body: These terms may be updated at any time. Sellers are asked to accept the current terms every time they post or edit a listing.

report.description: Tell the moderators what's wrong, like harassment, a scam, a prohibited item, or something you hold the copyright to.
report.thanks: Thanks — a moderator will review it.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summary: PirateHub is a free, independent community site for pirates. Be respectful, only post what you have the right to share, and remember that what other users post, organize, or sell is their responsibility — not PirateHub's.

about.heading: About PirateHub and these terms
about.body: PirateHub is an unofficial community site made for fun by a current Whitworth University student. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Whitworth University, and nothing on it is official university information. By creating an account or using PirateHub you agree to these Terms, the Privacy Policy, the Copyright Policy, and — if you use the marketplace — the Marketplace Terms. If you don't agree, please don't use PirateHub.

eligibility.heading: Accounts
eligibility.body: You must be at least 13 years old to use PirateHub. You agree to give accurate sign-up information, keep your password secure, and use only one account. You are responsible for everything that happens under your account.

content.heading: Your content
content.body: You keep ownership of what you post (posts, comments, events, listings, photos, videos, and files). By posting, you give PirateHub a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to host, store, display, and resize that content for the purpose of running the site. The license ends when you delete the content or your account, except for copies kept briefly in backups or where the law requires us to keep them. You confirm that you have the right to post everything you upload.

rules.heading: Community rules
rules.body: When using PirateHub you agree not to post or do any of the following:
items: Harassment, bullying, threats, hate speech, or content that targets someone
Sexual or pornographic content
Anything illegal, or anything that encourages illegal or dangerous activity
Spam, scams, phishing, or misleading content
Impersonating another person, club, or organization
Sharing someone else's personal information without their permission
Copyrighted material you don't have the right to share, including textbooks, publisher slides, and paid course materials
Exam answers, test banks, graded work meant for others, or anything that helps academic dishonesty
Malware, or attempts to break, overload, or get unauthorized access to PirateHub
Anything that violates campus policies

moderation.heading: Moderation
moderation.body: PirateHub uses automated tools (including a third-party moderation service) and volunteer moderators to screen content. We may review, hold, edit, or remove any content and suspend or delete any account at our discretion, with or without notice. We are not obligated to monitor everything, and moderation does not mean we have verified or endorse any content. If you see something that breaks these rules, please use the Report button.

events.heading: Events, campus guide, and map
events.body: Events are posted by users and organizers, not by PirateHub. We don't organize, host, supervise, or insure events, and you attend them at your own risk. Campus guide and map information is provided for convenience and may be outdated or wrong — check official sources for anything important.

marketplace.heading: Marketplace
marketplace.body: The marketplace only displays listings. PirateHub is not a party to any sale and doesn't handle payments, delivery, or disputes. Using the marketplace means you also agree to the Marketplace Terms.

thirdParty.heading: Links and third-party services
thirdParty.body: PirateHub links to other websites and uses third-party services such as Google Maps. We don't control them and aren't responsible for their content, availability, or practices.

copyright.heading: Copyright
copyright.body: We respond to copyright complaints as described in the Copyright Policy, and we disable the accounts of repeat infringers.

disclaimers.heading: No warranties
disclaimers.body: PirateHub is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We don't promise that the site will always be available, secure, or error-free, or that any content on it is accurate. We may change or shut down any part of PirateHub at any time.

liability.heading: Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, PirateHub and its operators are not liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for any loss of data, money, or opportunity, arising from your use of PirateHub or from the content or conduct of any user — online or offline. Because PirateHub is free, our total liability for any claim is limited to $50.

indemnity.heading: Your responsibility to us
indemnity.body: You agree to defend and hold harmless PirateHub and its operators from any claims, damages, or costs (including reasonable legal fees) arising from your content, your use of PirateHub, or your violation of these Terms or of anyone else's rights.

termination.heading: Ending your use
termination.body: You can delete your account at any time from your profile page. We may suspend or delete accounts that break these Terms. The sections about content licenses that are still needed, warranties, liability, and your responsibility to us continue to apply afterwards.

changes.heading: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms. When we make important changes we'll update the date above and, where reasonable, let you know on the site. Continuing to use PirateHub after a change means you accept the new Terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: We collect only what PirateHub needs to work, we never sell your data or show ads, and you can delete your account and everything you posted at any time.

intro.heading: About this policy
intro.body: This policy explains what information PirateHub collects, how it is used, who it is shared with, and the choices you have. PirateHub is an unofficial site made by a Whitworth University student; it is not operated by Whitworth University, and the university does not receive your information from us.

collect.heading: What we collect
items: Account information: your name, email address, and password (stored only as a secure hash, never in plain text)
Your profile picture, if you upload one
What you post: posts, comments, votes, events, marketplace listings (including the contact info you choose to show), photos, videos, files, and reports
Technical information: your IP address and browser type, saved with each login session to keep your account secure
Anonymous usage statistics (page views) through Vercel Web Analytics, which does not use cookies or identify you
Your language preference

use.heading: How we use it
use.body: We use this information to run PirateHub: to create and secure your account, send verification and password-reset emails, show your content to other users, moderate content and keep the community safe, prevent spam and abuse, and fix problems. We do not sell your information, use it for advertising, or share it for cross-site tracking.

sharing.heading: Who sees it and who we share it with
sharing.body: Your name, profile picture, and anything you post are visible to other visitors. Marketplace contact info is shown only to signed-in users. Moderators and admins can see your email address in moderation tools. We use these service providers to run the site, and they process data only on our behalf:
items: Vercel — hosting, file storage, and anonymous analytics
Neon — database hosting
Resend — sending account emails
OpenAI — the text of posts, comments, events, and listings is sent to OpenAI's moderation service to screen for harmful content
Google Maps — the map page loads Google's map service, which receives your IP address

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: PirateHub uses a session cookie to keep you logged in and a cookie to remember your language. Your light/dark theme choice is stored in your browser. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.

retention.heading: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep your information while your account exists. When you delete your account, we delete your account details, posts, comments, votes, listings, and uploaded files. Events you organized stay up without your name. Copies may remain in backups for a short time, and expired login sessions are cleaned up automatically.

rights.heading: Your choices and rights
rights.body: You can update your name and photo and delete your account at any time from your profile page. You can also email {email} to ask for a copy of your information or for help correcting or deleting it. Depending on where you live (for example, California), you may have additional privacy rights; we will honor them. We don't sell or share personal information as those laws define it.

children.heading: Children
children.body: PirateHub is not meant for anyone under 13, and we don't knowingly collect information from children under 13. If you believe a child has created an account, contact us and we will delete it.

security.heading: Security
security.body: We use HTTPS, hashed passwords, and access controls to protect your information, but no website can be perfectly secure. Use a unique password for PirateHub.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy. When we make important changes we'll update the date above and, where reasonable, let you know on the site.

copyrightPolicy.title: Copyright Policy
copyrightPolicy.summary: Only upload what you have the right to share. If you believe something on PirateHub infringes your copyright, send a notice to {email} and we will remove it.

intro.heading: Our approach
intro.body: PirateHub respects intellectual property rights and responds to notices of alleged copyright infringement under the U.S. Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA).

courseMaterials.heading: Course materials and textbooks
courseMaterials.body: Don't upload textbooks, publisher slides, paid course materials, test banks, or other work you don't own or have permission to share. Your own notes and work are fine to share, as long as your course rules allow it.

notice.heading: How to send a takedown notice
notice.body: If you believe content on PirateHub infringes your copyright, send a written notice that includes:
items: Your physical or electronic signature
A description of the copyrighted work you believe is infringed
The link (URL) to the content on PirateHub you want removed
Your name, address, phone number, and email address
A statement that you have a good-faith belief that the use is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law
A statement that the information in your notice is accurate and, under penalty of perjury, that you are the copyright owner or authorized to act on their behalf

agent.heading: Where to send it
agent.body: Send notices to PirateHub's designated copyright agent at {email}. We will remove or disable access to the content and, where possible, notify the user who posted it.

counter.heading: Counter-notices
counter.body: If your content was removed and you believe it was a mistake or misidentification, you can send a counter-notice to {email} with your signature, the removed content and where it appeared, a statement under penalty of perjury that you believe it was removed by mistake, and your name, address, and phone number with consent to the jurisdiction of the federal court for your address. We may restore the content 10–14 business days later unless the complainant tells us they have filed a lawsuit.

repeat.heading: Repeat infringers
repeat.body: We disable the accounts of users who repeatedly infringe copyright.

misrepresentation.heading: False claims
misrepresentation.body: Knowingly misrepresenting that content infringes, or that it was removed by mistake, can make you liable for damages under the DMCA.
